text: He says the same as what the muezzin says, except in “Hayya to Salat” and “Hayya ‘ala Al-Falah”, so he says: There is no power nor strength except in Allah.
He prays upon the Prophet - may God bless him and grant him peace - after he finishes answering the muezzin
He says: 'O God, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, give Muhammad the means and virtue, and raise him to the praiseworthy position which You promised him.'
He supplicates for himself between the call to prayer and the iqamah, as the supplication in that case will not be rejected
